short: live adapters over external CLIs and APIs
is: The live port implementations: a directory design source, a shell gate, the GitHub board and forge through gh, the Forgejo board and forge over its REST API through curl, a jj VCS, a process runner and the system shell; what both issue boards share (kind labels, state rules, comment notes) lives once beside them.
conventions: Backends are reached by shelling out (gh, jj, curl, sh -c), never through a client library

Each CLI has one door: every gh call goes through GhCommand (github/command.rs), every jj call through jj/command.rs, every Forgejo call through ForgejoApi (forgejo/api.rs); a failed call becomes a PortError (Backend carrying stderr or Forgejo's message, NotFound for a 404 or a missing issue, Unavailable for a missing program or an instance that does not answer)
A token never reaches argv, a manifest or a log: ForgejoApi hands it to curl in a config on stdin, and ForgejoToken's Debug hides it
Values substituted into a shell template are single-quoted

fs.name: design.rs
fs.role: DirDesign: Markdown pages beside an index, subfolders included, for repo-dir and git-sibling

fs.name: forgejo/
fs.role: ForgejoBoard on a repository's issues (an epic depends on its tasks; state/<state> and type/<Type> exclusive scoped labels, forgejo/labels.rs), ForgejoForge on its pull requests (a check is the latest commit status of a context at the head, forgejo/forge.rs), the doctor access checks both ask (forgejo/access.rs), ForgejoApi the curl door to /api/v1 with the token on stdin (its version read and shorter time limits serve setup's probe), Forgejo JSON rows and RFC 3339 times with an offset

fs.name: gate.rs
fs.role: ShellGate: [gate] lines by sh -c, output logged under .zaf/runs/

fs.name: github/
fs.role: board on issues or a Project (state in labels or a Project field, github/state.rs), forge on PRs and their writes (pr list/create, pr view/merge, pr checks, run view --log-failed, through GhCommand::run where the exit code alone does not decide), GhCommand with gh api graphql, gh JSON rows

fs.name: issues.rs
fs.role: the kind labels (task, epic, question, door, group:<name>) and the state rules (can wait, waits on a ruling, keeps its state on release) both issue boards share

fs.name: jj.rs
fs.role: JjVcs: a slice is a jj workspace plus a same-named bookmark

fs.name: notes.rs
fs.role: the comments both issue boards write and read back: lease lines and the live claim, reports, rulings, signatures, an epic's notes

fs.name: process.rs
fs.role: the process table: a Holder (pid plus start time), whether it still runs, and this process's ancestors, from /proc or ps

fs.name: runner.rs
fs.role: ProcessRunner: a role run as a [runners.<name>] command template

fs.name: shell.rs
fs.role: SystemShell: sh -c in its own process group, killed past a time bound

notes: Claims and heartbeats are plain issue comments; reports and rulings open with a hidden HTML marker (notes.rs, shared by both issue boards)
github/tests.rs puts zaf/tests/fixtures/gh first on PATH, forgejo/tests.rs puts zaf/tests/fixtures/forgejo (a fake curl) first; jj/tests.rs drives a real jj
One adapter per kind today: board github-issues, github-projects or forgejo-issues, forge github or forgejo, vcs jj, design repo-dir or git-sibling; a git Vcs adapter is a named later use case
The gate's run folder carries a .gitignore of `*`, so gate logs never show as uncommitted work
A GraphQL call GitHub calls transient (two writes to one Project at once) is tried three more times; unit tests zero the pauses
Forgejo lets two labels share a name and its label filter then matches neither: the board creates a label only when the list lacks it, and deletes its own when an older one of the name turned up
